verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a first-party Workflows feature that triggers automation on incident events, such as auto-publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. The evidence shows only this one status-page use case. Condition logic, reminders and field-change actions are not shown. Missing for 10: documented condition/filter logic in workflows, reminder/nudge actions, automated incident field changes, breadth of trigger types and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: With Workflows, you can automatically publish to your status page when an incident is updated.
Automatically updating your status page means you can make your customers aware of problems immediately, and remove a step from your incident response process.
